selection: minimum common absolute validation RMSE; no test-based selection
ranking_groups: WT feature path + reference + method + raw temperature + WT pKd rounded to 12 significant digits; missing metadata isolates records
ranking_replicates: Mean mutant pKd for identical mutant feature paths within the same experiment group
ranking_scaling: Hinge divided by common TRAIN target standard deviation; loss weights fixed as pilot, no test tuning
notes: No new labels: ranking reuses experimental endpoints.
Equal experimental groups for ranking, equal PDBs for numeric differences, equal sources/PDBs for absolutes.
Raw temperature distinguishes assumed and reported values; unrecorded pH/buffer/assay details cannot be guaranteed identical.
Full shuffled eligible-group coverage per epoch plus prefix; uniform comparison draws with replacement inside each selected group.
Three seeds share tests. Bootstrap homology groups, not mutation rows or seeds; previously examined test is diagnostic.
Additive readout, encoder adapters and external ddG predictors excluded from this first supervision experiment.
